question: You need to configure a bond in Cumulus Linux. Which command should you use? A. nv set interface bond1 bond mode lacp B. nv set bondbond1 interface member swp1-4 C. nv set interface bond1 bond member swp1-4 D. nv set interface bond1 bond mlag enable
